howto.line: Each line follows one group over the years. Click or tap a point to see its value.
caveat.dates: Figures are counted as at 1 January in earlier years and 30 June in recent years, so some points are 1.5 years apart.
caveat.over100: Completion rates can go above 100% because very few students drop out, and a small number repeat a grade or move between states.
def.students: Number of students enrolled in government schools.
def.teachers: Number of teachers in government primary and secondary schools.
def.schools: Number of government primary schools and government secondary schools.
def.completion: Share of students who complete a stage of education, relative to the cohort that started that stage.
